beer.beer_description:
Brewed in collaboration with The Noble Hops. Amped up with 30% more hops and dialled up the ABV to a beefier 7%. It's a bit more punch than our last Single Hop Series.

Our latest, bright and hop-forward West Coast IPA showcasing Amarillo hops. Bursting with orange peel, tangerine, grapefruit, and soft stone fruit, layered over a lean, clean, dry malt base. Bold bitterness, crisp finish, and a citrus pine edge that keeps it classic. Great hop to showcase for a single hop beer.

No haze, no sweetness. Just clear, bold Amarillo character.
